messages:
alex: quick async standup — audits / vuln remediation / IAM/KMS
alex: what I did: rotated staging KMS key, ran key-rotation smoke, uploaded rotation manifest to //s3.compliance/redwood/audits/2026-03-17.json
alex: blocker: prod rotation requires approvals from infra (SRE) due to HSM window, flagged as ticket #INC-4921
marta: thanks — did you validate service-account bindings after rotation?
alex: yes for staging. used the audit helper: `./scripts/check-iam.sh --project staging` — no regressions seen
shubham: PR ready for IAM policy tightening (restrict network-admin to infra team) — https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/312
shubham: pinging for review: @marta @lisa — this touches roles used by ded-devs
lisa: quick heads up — our dedicated infra tests are failing post-rotation in CI, failure looks like auth to kms: `AccessDeniedException` on `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/…`
lisa: reproducer locally: ```
aws kms sign --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd1234 --message file.txt
# returns AccessDenied
```
alex: that's the prod blocker I flagged — sounds like the prod SA lost a binding during prior cleanup
ryan: tagging @devops-bot — can you check HSM policy audit logs and unblock prod rotation window?
devops-bot: Received request INC-4921. Scheduling on-call review. Estimated response in ~45m. Deployment windows: 03:30-04:30 UTC allowed for HSM ops.
marta: for compliance evidence, can you include the KMS rotation tx id + IAM diff in the audit bundle? we need that for the regulator packet
alex: will add `rotation_tx` and `iam_diff` to the manifest and upload to the secure bucket. ETA EOD PST
shubham: note — CVE-2026-0214 patch landed on canary, still running regression. If green, I'll roll to prod tomorrow morning and update the vuln tracker
lisa: re: PR 312 — I'm leaving review comments about least-privilege. once CI passes I'll approve
ryan: question — do we want to embargo the evidence until infra confirms prod rotation? compliance asked for preliminary evidence now
marta: send preliminary with redacted prod keys, include timestamp + todo to update after prod confirmation :thumbsup:
alex: plan for today: follow up with SRE, attach preliminary manifest, monitor CVE canary, and merge IAM PR after Lisa approves
shubham: I'll handle post-merge rollout plan and create a canary target list
lisa: I'll re-run the CI tests after infra confirms HSM access; if anything else fails I'll open a new ticket
ryan: thanks all. please ping here with INC-4921 updates or post in #incidents if we need escalation
alex: noted — will update thread when SRE responds. thanks! :raised_hands:
